findings.title: Distinct positive minimal ANM DAGs contain a conditionally reversible edge
findings.exact_source_evidence: The fenced TikZ diagram immediately follows the prose description of one representative from each incident-edge class in G and G′.
findings.visible_defect: In screenshot tile 03 and matching frozen ItemBody HTML, the complete fenced TikZ source is printed literally in a preformatted code block rather than rendered as the schematic. The capture receipt reports tikz_count 0 and no diagram failures, so its detector did not recognize the source as a diagram.
findings.mathematical_context: The prose and source specify arrows c→l, y→l, w→l in G; c→l, d→l, l→y, l→e in G′; w is nonadjacent to l in G′.
findings.suggested_repair: Make the source fence compatible with renderer TikZ recognition, then recapture and confirm the schematic renders. The adjacent prose correctly states that the proof does not rely on the drawing.

existing_diagrams_reviewed.result: rendered legibly; two four-cycles shown with no cross-edges, matching the written edge set
rendered legibly; feature masses agree and only the unobserved label at b changes

diagram_review.candidate_rationale: No additional omitted diagram was sufficiently high-likelihood to report. The existing diagrams cover the concrete graph and two-law comparison. Remaining items are definitions, procedures, inequalities and proofs whose relations are adequately specified in text and equations; optional diagrams were not elevated to findings.

limitations: Local frozen HTML and Chromium screenshot review only; no production route or live site was inspected. Rendering evidence does not constitute a mathematical proof audit.
